related_questions.question: How to find out what medications are covered by your insurance?
related_questions.snippet: Call your insurer directly to find out what is covered. Have your plan information available. The number is available on your insurance card the insurer's website, or the detailed plan description in your Marketplace account. Review any coverage materials that your plan mailed to you.

related_questions.question: Does Highmark insurance cover prescriptions?
related_questions.snippet: In most cases, your prescriptions are covered under your Highmark plan only if they are filled at a network pharmacy or through our mail-order pharmacy service. A network pharmacy is a pharmacy that has agreed to provide prescription drug benefits at negotiated prices for Highmark members.

related_questions.question: How to get formulary from insurance?
related_questions.snippet: If you're considering a new health insurance plan, you can typically find a link for the formulary in the summary of benefits and coverage. If you're already enrolled in a plan, you can find your formulary on your health insurer's website. You must know the name of your plan to check the formulary that applies to you.

related_questions.question: How to get a formulary exception for medication?
related_questions.snippet: Your doctor is your ally on this. Most plans require that your doctor submit a formulary exception on your behalf. The doctor will need to send paperwork to your health plan indicating the reason that you can't take the preferred medications and must have one that is not currently on the formulary.
